articles.title: Clarity Act could spark a boom in crypto ‘yield-as-a-service’
articles.snippet: The bill’s restrictions on yield-bearing crypto products may push the industry away from passive "hold-to-earn" models and toward AI-driven, compliant yield infrastructure, according to STBL Chief Commercial Officer Joe Vollono.

articles.title: Robinhood Crypto COO Tanya Denisova is leaving company amid revenue slowdown
articles.snippet: Robinhood Crypto COO Tanya Denisova is leaving the firm after more than five years, as the trading platform navigates a sharp decline in crypto revenue and works to lessen its dependence on digital asset market cycles.

articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: NEAR surges 19.4% as index trades flat
articles.snippet: Internet Computer (ICP), up 4.3% from Thursday, joined NEAR Protocol (NEAR) as a top performer.

articles.title: Trump Media moved but 'did not sell' $205 million in bitcoin amid rising losses on crypto bets
articles.snippet: DJT’s bitcoin strategy remains under pressure as the company sits on hundreds of millions in unrealized crypto losses and widening quarterly deficits.

articles.title: Ark Invest buys $12.5 million of Bullish stock in four days
articles.snippet: Ark frequently uses broader digital asset downturns, which tend to pull crypto equities lower, as an entry point into cryptocurrency companies.
